newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Group to acquire CTB Inc assets.
newsitem.headline: Royal Group to acquire CTB Inc assets.

text.p: Royal Group Technologies Ltd said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the PVC extrusion assets business of CTB Inc for an undisclosed amount.
The deal is expected to close by May 15, Royal said in a statement.
Indiana-based CTB manufactures and distributes a line of plastic fence, deck and dock products.

Royal said the acquisition is in line with Royal's on-going strategy off locating manufacturing close to customers. It allows Royal to expand manufacturing operations in Indiana and add custom profile extruders to current facilities, the company said.
